verdict.rationale: Fireworks' own docs claim both embeddings and reranking for search and retrieval, list embedding models among its 100+ supported models, and its REST API covers embedding models. A retrieval pipeline could therefore run on Fireworks alone. The evidence is mostly one-line mentions, without endpoint-level detail. Missing for 10: dedicated embeddings/rerank API reference details (endpoints, model names, parameters), depth on reranking beyond a single mention, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate embeddings (and rerank results) for retrieval pipelines without a second vendor
